prompt:
You are watching a volleyball match from a fixed camera.

This clip begins at {start:.2f} seconds into the match.

List only specific meaningful volleyball events in live play. Do NOT report every touch (e.g., ignore normal passes and casual touches between rallies). For each event give:
  t       - the time of contact in absolute match seconds
  type    - must be one of:
            serve: initial hit from the baseline
            receive: first contact defending a serve
            dig: first contact defending an attack
            set: ONLY an assist that directly precedes a 'kill' (ignore passes before a normal 'attack')
            attack: any offensive hit sent over the net that does not score a point
            kill: an attack that directly scores a point and ends the rally
            block: deflecting an attack at the net
  side    - "left" or "right": which half of the frame the player is standing in
  number  - the player's jersey number as a string, or null if you cannot read it
  error   - true if the touch was a mistake
  point   - true if the rally ended here and a point was scored
